A Message from GrayStone's proud Owners:

Welcome to GrayStone; our family Chalet!

Years ago, Sun Peaks Resort was once called Tod Mountain, a family friendly ski area. The Gray family acquired this 1960’s chalet situated on the ski slopes in 1972. The only chairlift at the time was the Burfield Chair, a 22 minute ride to “the top of the world”! The mountain was the Kamloops local ski area well known for its “champagne powder”.

Four children were raised in this cabin, and were fondly known as the “Gray Girls”. This is where they learned how to ski every weekend with other Kamloops families. Tod Mountain would celebrate on special occasions called Wonder Weekend and Super Sunday where we would have competitions, costumes and BBQ’s. It was a small community with tons of spirit and heart.

By 2017, the original cabin was slowly falling apart and looking run down. A decision was made to rebuild instead of renovate. The new chalet is on the exact footprint as the original structure but has 3 floors instead of 2. It is more energy efficient with radiant heating and energy efficient exterior structures called SIP panels.

It was lovingly built with sweat and tears by the current owners two of them Gray Sisters. (Well actually, we couldn’t hammer a nail if we tried, it was more like the husbands built the cabin more on their own)! GrayStone Chalet was completed in December 2019.

There are many memories in its previous walls. We hope your stay here will be enjoyable and unforgettable and that the skiing will be awesome.

Other things to note
Please Note: The chalet has limited parking of Two Vehicles Only. No other nearby parking is available.
